families.label: Grounded question answering

domains.label: Product specifications
domains.subject: a product-specification excerpt
domains.context: The answer must come only from the stated features, limits, and compatibility notes.

domains.label: Policy excerpt
domains.subject: a short policy excerpt
domains.context: Defined terms, exceptions, and effective dates determine what the text supports.

domains.label: Science passage
domains.subject: a short science passage
domains.context: The passage contains an observation, an explanation, and a stated limit.

domains.label: Historical note
domains.subject: a historical note
domains.context: Dates, actors, and reported events must remain distinct from interpretation.

domains.label: Project brief
domains.subject: a project brief
domains.context: Goals, deliverables, owners, and unresolved dependencies are explicitly listed.

domains.label: Travel information
domains.subject: a travel-information notice
domains.context: Times, eligibility conditions, and service exceptions are stated in the notice.

domains.label: Technical documentation
domains.subject: a technical-documentation excerpt
domains.context: Supported behavior, prerequisites, and failure conditions are described directly.

domains.label: Comparison table
domains.subject: a compact comparison table
domains.context: Each option is described through the same named attributes and missing values remain visible.

domains.label: Conflicting service reports
domains.subject: two service reports with different scopes
domains.context: Align time, region, scope, and operation before comparison.

intents.label: answer the direct question
intents.goalTemplate: Answer a direct question about {subject} from the supplied evidence.

intents.label: locate supporting evidence
intents.goalTemplate: Locate the evidence in {subject} that supports a concise answer.

intents.label: compare two claims
intents.goalTemplate: Compare two claims against the evidence in {subject}.

intents.label: draw a cautious inference
intents.goalTemplate: Draw a bounded inference from {subject} without overstating it.

intents.label: identify what remains unknown
intents.goalTemplate: Identify what {subject} establishes and what remains unknown.

constraints.label: Use only information contained in the supplied context.
Tie every material answer to one visible piece of evidence.
Do not fill missing details with outside assumptions.
Keep the answer concise and focused on the question.
Separate stated facts from any inference.
Keep conflicting source statements visible instead of silently choosing one.

states.label: The context contains a direct answer.
The answer is distributed across several statements.
The context supports only part of the requested answer.
Two statements in the context appear to conflict.
The answer requires one limited inference from stated facts.

outcomes.label: The answer is fully supported by the supplied context.
The decisive evidence is identified in plain language.
The two claims are distinguished using the same evidence standard.
The inference is explicit, limited, and traceable to stated facts.
Any unsupported part of the question is marked as unknown.
The boundary of what the source can establish is clear.

fallbacks.label: Name the unresolved claim and suggest an authoritative source check.
Request the missing fact instead of inventing a bridge sentence.
Return to a smaller causal model with fewer moving parts.

responseContract: Answer from the supplied context only.

domains.label: Meeting transcript
domains.subject: a meeting transcript
domains.context: The source mixes decisions, open questions, owners, and conversational detail.

domains.label: Research notes
domains.subject: a set of research notes
domains.context: Findings, hypotheses, limitations, and follow-up ideas appear at different levels of confidence.

domains.label: Support thread
domains.subject: a customer-support thread
domains.context: Symptoms, attempted fixes, account facts, and unresolved questions are spread across several messages.

domains.label: Project update
domains.subject: a detailed project update
domains.context: Progress, blockers, dependencies, dates, and ownership need a compact shared view.

domains.label: Policy memo
domains.subject: a policy memo
domains.context: The memo contains a purpose, operative rules, exceptions, and implementation notes.

domains.label: Article excerpt
domains.subject: a long article excerpt
domains.context: The source contains a central claim, supporting points, qualifications, and illustrative detail.

domains.label: Incident log
domains.subject: an incident log
domains.context: Events, interventions, observed effects, and unresolved causes follow a time sequence.

domains.label: Learning notes
domains.subject: a collection of learning notes
domains.context: Definitions, examples, questions, and partial conclusions need a reusable structure.

intents.label: summarize the essentials
intents.goalTemplate: Summarize the essential information in {subject}.

intents.label: synthesize related points
intents.goalTemplate: Synthesize related points from {subject} without flattening disagreement.

intents.label: extract decisions and actions
intents.goalTemplate: Extract decisions and actions from {subject}.

intents.label: organize the chronology
intents.goalTemplate: Organize the chronology recorded in {subject}.

intents.label: adapt the summary for its audience
intents.goalTemplate: Adapt a faithful summary of {subject} for a stated audience.

constraints.label: Preserve every material claim from the source without adding new facts.
Remove repetition while retaining decisions, caveats, and unresolved questions.
Keep speakers or sources attached to claims when attribution matters.
Preserve uncertainty and disagreement instead of converting them into consensus.
Use a structure that makes the requested information easy to scan.
Distinguish central information from supporting detail.

states.label: The source is accurate but substantially too long.
Relevant information is scattered across the source.
Several points are repeated in slightly different wording.
Facts, interpretations, and open questions are mixed together.
The current summary does not match the reader's needs.

outcomes.label: The central information is captured without material omission.
Related points are combined while meaningful differences remain visible.
Decisions, owners, and next actions are easy to identify.
The sequence of events is accurate and easy to follow.
The summary serves the stated audience without changing the source meaning.
Unresolved questions and caveats remain explicit.

fallbacks.label: Retain the caveat explicitly when shortening the text.
Request the missing fact instead of inventing a bridge sentence.
Pause before commitment and preserve the current confirmed state.

families.label: Extraction and classification

domains.label: Receipt
domains.subject: a purchase receipt
domains.context: Dates, amounts, merchant details, taxes, and line items appear in semi-structured text.

domains.label: Event listing
domains.subject: an event listing
domains.context: Title, location, schedule, eligibility, and registration details need consistent fields.

domains.label: Contact record
domains.subject: a contact record
domains.context: Names, roles, organizations, and communication details must remain correctly associated.

domains.label: Issue ticket
domains.subject: a software issue ticket
domains.context: Symptoms, environment, severity, reproduction details, and status are mixed in prose.

domains.label: Survey response
domains.subject: a survey response
domains.context: The response contains a rating, a topic, free-form feedback, and possible ambiguity.

domains.label: Inventory record
domains.subject: an inventory record
domains.context: Item identity, quantity, location, condition, and update time require normalization.

domains.label: Schedule entry
domains.subject: a schedule entry
domains.context: Time, duration, participants, location, and recurrence need explicit representation.

domains.label: Case note
domains.subject: a short case note
domains.context: Observed facts, reported claims, actions, and pending items must remain distinguishable.

intents.label: extract the requested fields
intents.goalTemplate: Extract requested fields from {subject}.

intents.label: normalize the recorded values
intents.goalTemplate: Normalize the values in {subject} without changing their meaning.

intents.label: classify the record
intents.goalTemplate: Classify {subject} using a stated label set.

intents.label: identify missing required fields
intents.goalTemplate: Identify required information missing from {subject}.

intents.label: convert the record into a clear structure
intents.goalTemplate: Convert {subject} into a clear structured representation.

constraints.label: Use only fields defined by the requested schema.
Represent absent information explicitly instead of guessing a value.
Preserve source values unless a stated normalization rule applies.
Choose only from the provided classification labels.
Keep every extracted value traceable to the source text.
Return a syntactically valid structure with consistent field types.

states.label: All required information is present but unstructured.
At least one required field is absent.
Equivalent values use inconsistent formats.
The record could plausibly fit more than one label.
Relevant fields are mixed with unrelated prose.

outcomes.label: All supported requested fields are populated correctly.
Missing fields are represented explicitly without fabricated values.
Equivalent values use one documented format.
The selected class follows the stated label definition.
The output conforms to the requested schema and data types.
Every output value can be traced to its source evidence.

fallbacks.label: Request the missing fact instead of inventing a bridge sentence.
Pause before commitment and preserve the current confirmed state.
Name the unresolved claim and suggest an authoritative source check.

responseContract: Keep classifications tied to defined labels.

families.label: Reasoning and verification

domains.label: Shopping arithmetic
domains.subject: a small shopping calculation
domains.context: Prices, quantities, discounts, and a stated budget provide all necessary values.

domains.label: Schedule arithmetic
domains.subject: a scheduling calculation
domains.context: Start times, durations, breaks, and deadlines determine the feasible timeline.

domains.label: Unit conversion
domains.subject: a practical unit conversion
domains.context: The source provides the quantity, units, and conversion relationship.

domains.label: Proportions
domains.subject: a proportional reasoning problem
domains.context: Two known quantities define a ratio that must remain consistent.

domains.label: Table comparison
domains.subject: a numerical comparison table
domains.context: Several options share comparable measurements with occasional missing values.

domains.label: Sequence pattern
domains.subject: a short sequence problem
domains.context: A limited sequence supports one simple pattern that must be checked against every term.

domains.label: Logical constraints
domains.subject: a compact constraint problem
domains.context: A small set of explicit rules determines which combinations are possible.

domains.label: Simple probability
domains.subject: a basic probability question
domains.context: A finite set of equally described outcomes provides the stated sample space.

domains.label: Work allocation
domains.subject: an equal allocation across people and rounds
domains.context: The counts define an even allocation.

intents.label: calculate the requested result
intents.goalTemplate: Calculate the requested result for {subject}.

intents.label: compare the available quantities
intents.goalTemplate: Compare the available quantities in {subject}.

intents.label: test whether the constraint is satisfied
intents.goalTemplate: Test whether {subject} satisfies the stated constraint.

intents.label: explain the reasoning step by step
intents.goalTemplate: Explain the reasoning for {subject} in checkable steps.

intents.label: verify the proposed result
intents.goalTemplate: Verify a proposed result for {subject} independently.

constraints.label: Show the intermediate reasoning needed to check the result.
Use only the values and rules supplied in the problem.
Keep units attached to quantities throughout the calculation.
Use only the level of precision justified by the inputs.
Confirm the result through a second simple check.
Stop and identify any missing value required for a unique answer.

states.label: All required values and rules are present.
A candidate answer is available but has not been checked.
The quantities currently use different units.
Two reasoning paths produce different results.
One value required for a unique result is missing.

outcomes.label: The requested result follows from the supplied values and rules.
The quantities are compared on the same basis.
The constraint is shown to hold or fail for a specific reason.
Each reasoning step can be checked independently.
A second method confirms the proposed result.
The missing information required for a unique answer is explicit.

fallbacks.label: Return to a smaller causal model with fewer moving parts.
Use a counterexample to expose the exact point of confusion.
Name the unresolved claim and suggest an authoritative source check.

responseContract: Use only supplied values and rules.
Identify missing information instead of guessing.

domains.label: Email draft
domains.subject: a draft email
domains.context: The text has a clear purpose but may contain unnecessary friction or ambiguity.

domains.label: Argument
domains.subject: a short written argument
domains.context: The central claim, evidence, assumptions, and counterpoint can be inspected separately.

domains.label: Project plan
domains.subject: a small project plan
domains.context: The plan lists an objective, tasks, dependencies, owners, and completion criteria.

domains.label: Explanation
domains.subject: a draft explanation
domains.context: The explanation may be accurate while still hiding a key reasoning step from the reader.

domains.label: Instructions
domains.subject: a set of user instructions
domains.context: Order, prerequisites, warnings, and verification steps determine whether the instructions are usable.

domains.label: Summary
domains.subject: a draft summary
domains.context: The summary must preserve the source emphasis without carrying unnecessary detail.

domains.label: Claim and evidence note
domains.subject: a claim-and-evidence note
domains.context: Each claim should have proportionate support and unsupported interpretation must remain visible.

domains.label: Interface copy
domains.subject: a short interface message
domains.context: The text must orient the user, state the consequence, and offer a clear next action.

intents.label: identify the most important weakness
intents.goalTemplate: Identify the most important weakness in {subject}.

intents.label: revise the weak section
intents.goalTemplate: Revise the weakest section of {subject} without changing supported meaning.

intents.label: check internal consistency
intents.goalTemplate: Check {subject} for internal consistency.

intents.label: strengthen the evidence connection
intents.goalTemplate: Strengthen the connection between claims and evidence in {subject}.

intents.label: prioritize the necessary fixes
intents.goalTemplate: Prioritize the fixes that would most improve {subject}.

constraints.label: Tie every criticism to a specific part of the draft.
Preserve the author's supported purpose and meaning.
Do not invent facts, evidence, or commitments during revision.
Separate blocking problems from optional improvements.
Make every recommended change concrete enough to apply.
Keep the depth of critique proportionate to the requested scope.

states.label: The main point is present but difficult to identify.
A material claim lacks visible support.
Two parts of the draft do not agree.
Too many secondary issues obscure the central task.
The draft is usable but needs one focused correction.

outcomes.label: The highest-impact weakness is identified with a clear reason.
The revised section is clearer without adding unsupported meaning.
The relevant parts of the draft use compatible claims and terms.
Each material claim has proportionate visible support.
Required fixes are ordered by impact and dependency.
Every proposed change can be reviewed against the source draft.

fallbacks.label: Retain the caveat explicitly when shortening the text.
Request the missing fact instead of inventing a bridge sentence.
Pause before commitment and preserve the current confirmed state.

domains.label: Names and labels
domains.subject: a set of names for a small project
domains.context: The options should be memorable, distinct, and appropriate for a stated audience.

domains.label: Learning activity
domains.subject: a short learning activity
domains.context: The activity should connect one learning objective to observable participation.

domains.label: Event ideas
domains.subject: ideas for a small community event
domains.context: Available time, space, accessibility, and budget constrain the format.

domains.label: Feature ideas
domains.subject: feature ideas for a simple product
domains.context: Each idea should address a named user need without expanding the scope uncontrollably.

domains.label: Writing prompts
domains.subject: a set of short writing prompts
domains.context: The prompts should vary in perspective while respecting a shared theme and audience.

domains.label: Low-cost activities
domains.subject: ideas for a low-cost activity
domains.context: The activity must use common materials and avoid hidden costs or specialist access.

domains.label: Outreach ideas
domains.subject: ideas for a small outreach effort
domains.context: The message, channel, audience, and desired response should align.

domains.label: Workflow improvements
domains.subject: ideas for improving a simple workflow
domains.context: Suggestions should reduce friction without removing necessary checks.

intents.label: generate several distinct options
intents.goalTemplate: Generate several distinct options for {subject}.

intents.label: diversify the current ideas
intents.goalTemplate: Diversify the current ideas for {subject}.

intents.label: filter ideas against the criteria
intents.goalTemplate: Filter ideas for {subject} against explicit criteria.

intents.label: combine compatible concepts
intents.goalTemplate: Combine compatible concepts into stronger options for {subject}.

intents.label: develop one promising idea
intents.goalTemplate: Develop one promising idea for {subject} into a bounded proposal.

constraints.label: Make the options meaningfully different rather than cosmetic rewrites.
Keep every option feasible within the stated resources.
Keep the intended audience visible in each option.
Avoid ideas that create unnecessary safety, privacy, or exclusion risks.
Explain briefly how each retained option meets the named criteria.
Keep the proposal small enough to test and revise.

states.label: No candidate idea has been proposed yet.
The current ideas are too similar to one another.
The current concept is too broad to evaluate.
One appealing idea conflicts with a hard constraint.
One option is promising but not yet concrete.

outcomes.label: The candidate options differ in a meaningful and useful way.
Each retained option satisfies the stated criteria.
The remaining ideas are feasible within the available resources.
Compatible strengths are combined without preserving their conflicts.
One idea is developed into a small testable proposal.
The main trade-off of each leading option is visible.

fallbacks.label: Choose a smaller reversible scope that still tests the plan.
Pause before commitment and preserve the current confirmed state.
Request the missing fact instead of inventing a bridge sentence.

responseContract: Develop ideas only to a testable scope.

families.label: Context tracking and clarification

domains.label: Ambiguous request
domains.subject: an ambiguous request
domains.context: Several interpretations are possible and one choice would materially change the answer.

domains.label: Missing reference
domains.subject: a request that refers to missing material
domains.context: The requested work depends on a document, image, value, or earlier message that is not available.

domains.label: Conflicting instruction
domains.subject: a request with conflicting instructions
domains.context: Two stated requirements cannot both be satisfied without a priority decision.

domains.label: Unclear reference
domains.subject: a request with an unclear reference
domains.context: A pronoun or short label could refer to more than one previously mentioned item.

domains.label: Incomplete goal
domains.subject: a request with an incomplete objective
domains.context: The activity is named but the intended result is not yet defined.

domains.label: Scope boundary
domains.subject: a request with an uncertain scope
domains.context: A narrow interpretation is safe while a broader interpretation would add unapproved work.

domains.label: Output format
domains.subject: a request with an unspecified output format
domains.context: The content is clear but length, structure, or delivery format could change its usefulness.

domains.label: Timeline ambiguity
domains.subject: a request with an unclear time frame
domains.context: Relative dates or urgency language do not identify a dependable deadline.

intents.label: ask one decisive clarifying question
intents.goalTemplate: Ask one decisive question that resolves the ambiguity in {subject}.

intents.label: restate the understood request
intents.goalTemplate: Restate the understood portion of {subject} for confirmation.

intents.label: resolve the ambiguous reference
intents.goalTemplate: Resolve the ambiguous reference in {subject}.

intents.label: separate facts from assumptions
intents.goalTemplate: Separate confirmed facts from assumptions in {subject}.

intents.label: propose a bounded interpretation
intents.goalTemplate: Propose a bounded reversible interpretation of {subject}.

constraints.label: Ask no more than one question before offering a useful bounded step.
Do not silently choose an interpretation that changes the requested outcome.
Preserve every part of the request that is already clear.
Clarify only ambiguity that materially affects the result.
Keep any provisional interpretation easy to revise.
Label any temporary assumption explicitly.

states.label: Two interpretations are equally plausible.
A required input is not available.
Two requirements point to incompatible results.
The request is mostly clear except for one material detail.
A narrow reversible default is available.

outcomes.label: One concise question isolates the decision that only the requester can make.
The understood scope is restated clearly for confirmation.
The intended referent is identified without changing the request.
Confirmed facts and temporary assumptions are visibly separated.
Useful reversible progress is possible while awaiting clarification.
The incompatible requirements and required priority choice are explicit.

fallbacks.label: Request the missing fact instead of inventing a bridge sentence.
Pause before commitment and preserve the current confirmed state.
Choose a smaller reversible scope that still tests the plan.

responseContract: Ask at most one decisive question.
